description: Use to diagnose VMware/vSphere/ESXi/NSX incidents: errors, log dumps, slow VMs, disconnected hosts, or an unexplained failure. Correlates companion-skill evidence into a timeline, ranks root-cause hypotheses, and recommends the next check. Trigger on "diagnose this VMware issue", "why is my VM slow", "troubleshoot this vSphere error" or "what does this log mean". Its CLI/MCP tools make no VMware API calls or repairs; optional Python host bindings call explicitly supplied companion MCP sessions; writes local case records and a separate audit trail. Default stdio is local; optional authenticated HTTPS uses caller tokens and TLS files. Route fixes to vmware-aiops (single action) or vmware-pilot (gated workflow), and routine inventory/health without an incident to vmware-monitor.
